summary: Faraday Future filed an 8-K on August 20, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its March 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement with investors. The amendment splits the remaining fourth closing into two closings, eliminates the issuance of Common Warrants and Incremental Warrants at remaining closings, and reallocates note commitments among investors. The amended notes have a revised conversion price. No new financing terms or prices were detailed in the excerpt. The event is a modification of an existing financing agreement, not a special situation. Watch for updates on the fourth closing and conversion price adjustments.
